statusKey.implemented-unverified: Built; verified only by offline tests (local node, exchange test double) or not at all. Not shown on testnet.
statusKey.testnet-verified: Observed on Elysium testnet and Hyperliquid testnet with public records.
statusKey.mainnet-verified: Observed on mainnet. Nothing in this project is at this status.
statusKey.simulated: Produced by simulation. Nothing in this project is at this status.

claims.claim: MandateRegistry, StapleDesk and libraries are deployed on Elysium testnet (chain 99801)
claims.limitation: Waiting on testnet gas for the deployer address.

claims.claim: Elysium intent → real HyperCore testnet order → independent observation → confirmed cancellation → reconciled outcome
claims.limitation: Waiting on testnet USDC in the dedicated owner account.

claims.claim: Solidity quote engine and the independent TypeScript reference agree on frozen vectors for precision, rounding, skew, bounded ladders, health rule and reservations
claims.limitation: Vectors cover chosen cases; they are not a proof of equivalence.

claims.claim: Every potentially executable order (placed, acknowledged, resting, partially filled, unknown, awaiting cancel, replaced) is reserved in the worst case; cancel requests never release capacity
claims.evidence: contracts/test/StapleDesk.t.sol (reservation, replacement, partial-fill and fuzz tests), keeper/test/integration.test.ts
claims.limitation: A policy invariant under reconciled inputs and compliant execution. It is not exchange-enforced against a compromised key or unrelated account activity.

claims.claim: Fills apply exactly once per exchange trade id; observations and outcome batches are replay-protected and EIP-712 domain-separated by chain and contract
claims.evidence: contracts/test/StapleDesk.t.sol (replay, domain separation, duplicate and late fills)
claims.limitation: Signatures authenticate the reporter, not the truth of reported data.

claims.claim: Stale-data and expiry shutdowns are initiated by a timer (permissionless poke called by the watcher) even when no observation arrives
claims.evidence: contracts/test/StapleDesk.t.sol test_staleShutdownWithoutAnyNewTick, test_expiryWithoutTick; keeper/test/integration.test.ts keeper outage
claims.limitation: Requires the watcher (or anyone) to send the poke transaction; the exchange-side scheduled cancel is the second line.

claims.claim: Keeper renews Hyperliquid scheduleCancel 90 s ahead while orders may rest
claims.evidence: keeper/src/keeper.ts renewScheduleCancel; signing verified against hyperliquid-python-sdk
claims.limitation: Hyperliquid allows at most 10 triggers per day; not yet observed firing on testnet.

claims.claim: Unknown placements are resolved by status query after an exchange-enforced expiry, never by blind retry; restart recovery reconciles before new exposure
claims.limitation: Exercised against an exchange test double, not the live exchange.

claims.claim: Loss trigger stops quoting and requests cancellation; trigger time, loss at trigger, peak loss, overshoot and confirmed cancellation time are recorded
claims.limitation: Not a cap. Loss can exceed the trigger; residual inventory keeps market risk.

claims.claim: An independent watcher (separate Python implementation and keys) reconciles every exchange order and fill against intents with an all-activity denominator, reports mismatches on-chain and heartbeats; quoting fails closed without it
claims.limitation: Runs on the same host as the keeper in the hosted setup; independence is in code and keys, not hardware. It cannot undo trades.

claims.claim: Cancel-all-and-revoke is a five-step flow with each step confirmed separately; revocation does not imply cancellation
claims.limitation: Agent removal by approving the zero address under the same name must be verified on testnet.

claims.claim: Public mandate page separates intended, observed and unconfirmed orders, shows inventory, reservations, PnL/fees, thresholds, watcher health, residual risk and history from on-chain decisions
claims.limitation: Not yet exercised against a live deployment.

claims.claim: Mandate-on vs mandate-off time-at-target measured by an independent sampler
claims.limitation: No campaign has run. No results are claimed.
